user_before.name: Dr Jeremy Sun Mingfa
user_before.description: Dr Jeremy Sun Mingfa is a Senior Consultant Plastic and Reconstructive Surgeon in Singapore with subspecialty expertise in lymphatic surgery and supermicrosurgical lymphatic reconstruction. He is a Consultant with the Department of Surgery at Changi General Hospital and concurrently Director of the Plastic, Reconstructive and Aesthetic Surgery Service and Director of the Lymphoedema Service. He completed dedicated fellowship training in lymphatic reconstruction in Japan under internationally recognised experts and is among the early pioneers of structured lymphedema screening and surgical management in Singapore. Dr Sun has published peer-reviewed research on lymphedema, microsurgery, and reconstructive surgery, and lectures internationally on lymphatic preservation, early detection, and lymphatic reconstruction techniques. He currently serves as Chairman of the Chapter of Plastic, Reconstructive and Aesthetic Surgeons, Academy of Medicine Singapore. Learn more about Dr Jeremy Sun Mingfa here.
